name: Resumeet
author: CristoSolar
description: Record, transcribe and summarize meetings, fully offline. A bar widget toggles recording and shows elapsed minutes. ffmpeg captures your mic and the system audio as two tracks, so you get speaker separation without diarization; whisper.cpp transcribes locally, and your own prompt files turn the transcript into a summary or next steps. A local viewer lists every meeting with its notes, transcript and audio. Only the prompt step calls an LLM, and you pick the command.

barWidget.description: Meeting recording indicator: elapsed minutes, click to start or stop.
